_comment: Starter catalog — extend with org KPIs. Each metric is prompted in order; probes pre-fill where implemented.

metrics.title: Tasks marked done
metrics.description: Subset with status === "done" (if status omitted, not counted).

metrics.title: Assembly-line — dispatch completions (UTC day)
metrics.description: Count of cli_dispatch_end events in factory/telemetry/assembly-line for the snapshot day (0 if no log).

metrics.title: Assembly-line — failure-like events (UTC day)
metrics.description: operation_error or outcome fail (approximate signal for kaizen).

metrics.title: Last npm run check — outcome
metrics.description: Your attestation or result of the last check you care about; optional probe can offer to run (see CLI).

metrics.title: Last npm run mfg -- validate factory — outcome
metrics.description: Factory validators batch; attestation unless you use --probe-cli.

metrics.title: Last deploy preview dry-run — outcome
metrics.description: Gates-only deploy tier; attestation unless probed.

metrics.title: Top friction this week (one line)
metrics.description: Free text for retro / kaizen themes.
